# Task
Task: ajcr-build-reach
Title: Build reachability: root the 93 unrooted modules so the axiom probe actually sees them
Project(s) — work across all of them:
- Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild at MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild

Own AJCR.w4-rep.build-reach. Triage recorded 93 of 620 modules UNROOTED (47 dirty, 80 live). Re-measure first -- the count is days old and four lanes have been committing since.

WHY THIS MATTERS MORE THAN IT LOOKS. An adversarial audit on 2026-07-29 found the same defect on the AJC side: the entire RiemannRoch/Ledger/ layer, 17k lines, is imported by nothing in the root cone, so the standing axiom probe NEVER ELABORATES IT. Its '41/41 axiom-clean' was measured by bespoke scripts, not the root target. Unrooted code carries a materially weaker guarantee than rooted code, and the roadmap does not currently distinguish them.

DELIVERABLES: (1) a re-measured, committed census of unrooted modules; (2) as many as possible rooted into the umbrella, cheapest first; (3) for each module you CANNOT root, a one-line reason recorded on its hgraph node -- not in the blueprint. Report the residual count honestly; a partial result with an accurate census beats an optimistic claim.

CAUTION: narrowing or adding imports has broken no-Mathlib dependents in this workspace before. Build the affected module singly after each change; do not rely on lake env lean alone, which misses the style linters.

This is a headless, one-shot session: advance the REAL objective, commit each
verified unit and any final edits, keep operational comments to the delta,
then write the skill's brief final report.
